words.en: A trumpet is a brass musical instrument with a flared bell and three valves, producing a bright, penetrating tone.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.ex: He picked up the receiver to answer the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起听筒接电话。
words.en: A receiver is a person who receives something or a device that receives signals and converts them into sound or pictures.

words.ex: He will fasten his seatbelt before driving.
words.ex_cn: 他开车前会系好安全带。
words.en: To close or attach something firmly so that it will not open or come loose.

words.ex: They drank champagne at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上喝了香槟。
words.en: Champagne is an expensive French white wine with bubbles in. It is often drunk to celebrate something.

words.tr:
n. 树皮；
v. 狗吠；
words.ex: The dog climbed the tree and touched the bark.
words.ex_cn: 狗爬上了树，摸了摸树皮。
words.en: The sound a dog makes; the outer covering of a tree.

words.ex: I hereby declare my agreement.
words.ex_cn: 我据此声明我的同意。
words.en: You use hereby when you are making an official statement or declaration, or when you are formally stating something.

words.ex: They play basketball in the gymnasium.
words.ex_cn: 他们在体育馆打篮球。
words.en: A gymnasium is a large room or building with equipment for exercising the body and increasing strength.

words.ex: He tells humorous stories that make everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他讲一些幽默的故事，让大家都笑。
words.en: If you are humorous, you are able to be amusing and to make people laugh.

words.ex: The Gulf of Mexico is a large sea area.
words.ex_cn: 墨西哥湾是一个大型海域。
words.en: A gulf is a large area of sea that is partly surrounded by land.

words.tr:
n. 带扣；皮带扣
v. （使）搭扣扣住
words.ex: The belt has a shiny buckle.
words.ex_cn: 这条皮带有一个闪亮的带扣。
words.en: A buckle is a piece of metal or plastic attached to one end of a belt or strap, which is used to fasten it. As a verb, to buckle means to fasten something with a buckle or to bend or collapse under pressure.

words.ex: The sunset was spectacular.
words.ex_cn: 日落非常壮观。
words.en: Something that is spectacular is very impressive or dramatic.

words.tr:
v. 吹嘘；自吹自擂
adj. 一流的；极好的
words.ex: He brags about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他炫耀自己的新车。
words.en: If you brag, you say in a very proud way that you have something or have done something.

words.ex: There was a thin mist over the lake at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，湖面上有一层薄雾。
words.en: Mist is a thin layer of cloud that touches the ground. It is less dense than fog and can make it difficult to see clearly.

words.ex: The cow has two long horns.
words.ex_cn: 这头牛有两只长角。
words.en: A horn is a pointed projection on the head of various animals, consisting of a core of bone surrounded by a sheath of keratin, or a device for making a loud warning noise.

words.ex: He smokes a cigar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后抽一支雪茄。
words.en: A cigar is a tightly rolled bundle of dried and fermented tobacco leaves, which is ignited so that its smoke may be drawn into the mouth.

words.tr:
v. 皱眉；蹙额
n. 皱眉；蹙额
words.ex: He frowns when he hears bad news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到坏消息时会皱眉。
words.en: If you frown, you bring your eyebrows together so that there are lines on your face above your eyes, often because you are annoyed or worried.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.ex: He is jealous of his brother's new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他嫉妒他弟弟的新自行车。
words.en: If someone is jealous, they feel angry or bitter because they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.ex: He does arithmetic every day with his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和妹妹一起做算术。
words.en: Arithmetic is the part of mathematics that deals with the addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of numbers.

words.ex: My sister's daughter is my niece.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹的女儿是我的侄女。
words.en: Someone's niece is the daughter of their sister or brother.

words.ex: He is a conscientious student who always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个尽责的学生，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is conscientious is very careful to do their work properly.

words.ex: The ground is damp after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是潮湿的。
words.en: Something that is damp is slightly wet, often in a way that is unpleasant.

words.ex: We went sightseeing in Paris last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去巴黎观光了。
words.en: The activity of visiting places of interest in a particular location.

words.ex: He is clumsy and dropped the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他很笨拙，把玻璃杯打翻了。
words.en: A clumsy person moves or handles things in a careless, awkward way, often so that things are knocked over or broken.

words.ex: The heroine saves the town from the dragon.
words.ex_cn: 女主角拯救了小镇免受龙的侵害。
words.en: A heroine is a woman who is admired for her courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities, especially a woman who has performed a heroic act or is the main character in a story.

words.tr:
v. 舔；（火焰）掠过；克服
n. 舔；少许
words.ex: The dog licks its paw.
words.ex_cn: 狗舔它的爪子。
words.en: To pass the tongue over something; to defeat someone easily.

words.ex: They enclose the garden with a wooden fence.
words.ex_cn: 他们用木栅栏把花园围起来。
words.en: If you enclose something with a letter, you put it in the same envelope as the letter.

words.ex: He drank coffee from a large mug.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个大杯子里喝咖啡。
words.en: A mug is a large, deep cup with straight sides and a handle, used for hot drinks. It can also refer to someone's face or a foolish person. As a verb, it means to attack and rob someone violently in a public place.

words.ex: The prince is the heir to the throne.
words.ex_cn: 王子是王位的继承人。
words.en: A person legally entitled to inherit property or a title.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handbook for the science project.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们发了一本科学项目的手册。
words.en: A handbook is a type of reference work, or other collection of instructions, that is intended to provide ready reference.

words.ex: He jogs every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上慢跑以保持健康。
words.en: To run at a slow, steady pace, especially as a form of exercise.

words.ex: The purity of the water is checked every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天都会检查水的纯净度。
words.en: The quality or state of being pure, especially in terms of being free from anything that contaminates, pollutes, or dilutes.

words.tr:
adj. 浅色头发的；金色的；白皙的
n. 金发女郎
words.ex: The blonde girl is singing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个金发女孩正在公园里唱歌。
words.en: A blonde person has hair that is pale gold in color.

words.ex: He carried his baggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李带到了机场。
words.en: Baggage refers to the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel, or it can refer to emotional issues that someone carries with them from past experiences.

words.ex: The rubber band is elastic.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋是有弹性的。
words.en: An elastic material is able to stretch and then return to its original shape or size.

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.ex: His viewpoint is different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的不同。
words.en: A viewpoint is a particular way of thinking about something, especially one that is influenced by your experiences or beliefs.

words.tr:
v. 打呵欠
n. 呵欠
words.ex: He yawned during the boring lecture.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的讲座上打哈欠。
words.en: If you yawn, you open your mouth very wide and breathe in more air than usual, often because you are tired or bored.

words.ex: The teacher will allocate books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将给学生分配书籍。
words.en: To allocate something means to give it to a particular person or use it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He works in a lab that uses biotechnology.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个使用生物技术的实验室工作。
words.en: Biotechnology is the use of living cells and bacteria in industrial and scientific processes.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.ex: The fireman saved the cat from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 消防员从树上救下了那只猫。
words.en: A fireman is a person whose job is to put out fires and rescue people from dangerous situations, especially in buildings.

words.tr:
n. 鸽子；鸽派人物；温和派人物
v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的过去式
words.ex: The dove flew over the garden.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子飞过花园。
words.en: A dove is a bird that is often used as a symbol of peace. It is known for its gentle nature and the soft cooing sound it makes.

words.tr: adj. 多汁的；利润丰厚的；有趣味的
words.ex: The apple is juicy and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果多汁又甜。
words.en: If you describe something as juicy, you mean that it is very interesting or exciting, especially because it involves scandalous or personal information.

words.tr:
n. 锤子；
v. 锤打；
words.ex: He hit the nail with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子敲钉子。
words.en: A hammer is a tool that consists of a heavy piece of metal at the end of a handle, used for hitting things.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is bleeding.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口正在流血。
words.en: When you bleed, blood flows from your body, usually because you are injured.

words.ex: He used a torch to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A torch is a stick with a flame on one end that is used as a source of light, or a portable battery-powered electric lamp.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.ex: He bought a brass lamp at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个黄铜制品台灯。
words.en: Brass is a yellow-coloured metal made from copper and zinc. It is used especially for making ornaments and musical instruments.

words.ex: He caught influenza last winter.
words.ex_cn: 他去年冬天得了流感。
words.en: Influenza is an infectious disease caused by the influenza virus, characterized by fever, sore throat, muscle pain, severe headache, coughing, and weakness.

words.tr:
adj. 同性恋的
n. 同性恋者
words.ex: He is homosexual and loves his partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是同性恋，爱他的伴侣。
words.en: A homosexual is someone who is sexually attracted to people of the same sex.

words.ex: I congratulate you on your success.
words.ex_cn: 我祝贺你取得成功。
words.en: If you congratulate someone, you express pleasure for something good that has happened to them, or you praise them for something they have achieved.

words.ex: The cop stopped the car for speeding.
words.ex_cn: 警察因超速拦下了那辆车。
words.en: A cop is a police officer. To cop means to catch or arrest someone.

words.ex: He will surrender when he sees the police.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到警察时，他会投降。
words.en: If you surrender, you stop fighting or resisting someone and agree that you have been beaten.

words.ex: He gave his mother a massage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后给妈妈做了按摩。
words.en: The act of rubbing and pressing someone's body with the hands to reduce tension or pain in the muscles.

words.ex: He ate a sweet melon for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块甜瓜当甜点。
words.en: A melon is a large, juicy fruit with a hard rind, belonging to the gourd family, typically eaten fresh.

words.ex: He ate a sausage for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一根香肠。
words.en: A sausage is a type of meat product usually made from ground meat, often pork, beef, or poultry, along with salt, spices, and other flavorings. Other ingredients such as grains or breadcrumbs may be included as fillers or extenders.

words.ex: The defect in the phone made it hard to use.
words.ex_cn: 手机的缺陷让它很难使用。
words.en: A defect is a fault or imperfection in a person or thing.

words.ex: The continuity of the story made it easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的连续性让它容易理解。
words.en: Continuity is the fact that something continues to happen or exist, with no great changes or interruptions.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.ex: The bridegroom smiled at his bride on their wedding day.
words.ex_cn: 新郎在婚礼当天对新娘微笑。
words.en: A bridegroom is a man who is getting married or has just got married.

words.ex: The scandal caused a dent in his reputation.
words.ex_cn: 这场丑闻削弱了他的声誉。
words.en: A dent is a hollow or depression in a surface, often caused by a blow or pressure.

words.tr: n. 孤儿；失去生母的幼小动物
words.ex: The boy lives with his uncle because he is an orphan.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩和叔叔住在一起，因为他是个孤儿。
words.en: An orphan is a child whose parents are dead.

words.ex: The ship sailed inward toward the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船向港口内航行。
words.en: Directed or moving towards the inside; relating to the inside or inner part of something.

words.ex: The children found old toys in the attic.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在阁楼上找到了旧玩具。
words.en: An attic is a space or room just below the roof of a building, often used for storage or as an extra room.

words.ex: He grew a thick beard last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天他留了一脸浓密的胡须。
words.en: The hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.

words.ex: They had a bumper harvest this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年他们获得了异常大的收成。
words.en: A bumper is a bar at the front and back of a vehicle that reduces damage if the vehicle hits something.

words.tr: adj. 较合意的；更可取的；
words.ex: Tea is preferable to coffee in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上喝茶比喝咖啡更合意。
words.en: If you say that one thing is preferable to another, you mean that it is more desirable or suitable.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: The cat ran down the alley.
words.ex_cn: 猫跑进了小巷。
words.en: An alley is a narrow passage between buildings or other structures.

words.ex: The loud noise roused him from sleep.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音把他从睡梦中唤醒了。
words.en: If someone rouses you when you are sleeping or if you rouse, you wake up. / To rouse someone means to make them stop doing something and start doing something else.

words.ex: He drinks whisky every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上喝威士忌。
words.en: Whisky is a strong alcoholic drink made from grain such as barley or rye.

words.ex: She tied a red ribbon around the box.
words.ex_cn: 她把一条红色的带状物系在盒子上。
words.en: A ribbon is a long, narrow piece of cloth that you use for tying things together or as a decoration.

words.ex: A spider is crawling on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 一只蜘蛛正在墙上爬。
words.en: A spider is a small creature with eight legs and a body divided into two parts, which spins webs to catch insects for food.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.ex: The steam condenses into water when it touches the cold glass.
words.ex_cn: 当蒸汽接触到冷的玻璃时，会凝结成水。
words.en: If you condense something, especially a piece of writing or a speech, you make it shorter, usually by including only the most important parts.

words.ex: The formation of clouds happens when water vapor cools.
words.ex_cn: 云的形成发生在水蒸气冷却时。
words.en: The process of forming or making something, or the way something is formed or made.

words.ex: The senate voted to pass the new law.
words.ex_cn: 参议院投票通过了这项新法律。
words.en: The Senate is the smaller and more important of the two parts of the parliament in some countries, for example in the United States and Australia.

words.ex: The faint light from the candle barely lit the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛微弱的光几乎照不亮房间。
words.en: If you feel faint, you feel weak and as if you are about to lose consciousness. Something that is faint is not strong or clear.

words.ex: He forgot his password and could not log in.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了密码，无法登录。
words.en: A password is a secret word or phrase that you must know in order to be allowed to enter a place or to use a computer system.

words.tr: n. 一阵强劲的气流；爆炸；
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit the window.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风击中了窗户。
words.en: A blast is a sudden loud noise or a strong gust of wind. It can also refer to an explosion or the act of blowing something up. As a verb, it means to explode or to criticize severely.

words.ex: A mosquito bit my arm last night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蚊子昨晚咬了我的胳膊。
words.en: A mosquito is a small flying insect that bites people and animals in order to feed on their blood. Some mosquitoes can transmit diseases.

words.ex: The farmers work in the paddy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农民每天早上都在稻田里劳作。
words.en: A paddy is a field in which rice is grown. It is typically flooded with water.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.ex: He paid with a fifty-dollar banknote.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张五十美元的纸币付款。
words.en: A banknote is a piece of paper money, especially one issued by a central bank.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.tr:
n. 滞后；延迟；
v. 落后；缓慢移动；
words.ex: There is a lag between the signal and the response.
words.ex_cn: 信号和响应之间有滞后。
words.en: If one thing or person lags behind another thing or person, their progress is slower than that of the other.

words.ex: The bang woke me up at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 那声巨响在午夜把我吵醒了。
words.en: A bang is a sudden loud noise such as the noise of an explosion.

words.ex: The public condemned the corrupt politician.
words.ex_cn: 公众谴责了这位腐败的政客。
words.en: If you condemn something, you say that it is very bad and unacceptable.

words.ex: The teacher chose an arbitrary number to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师随意选了一个数字来开始游戏。
words.en: If you describe an action, rule, or decision as arbitrary, you think that it is not based on any principle, plan, or system. It often seems unfair because of this.

words.tr:
adj. 该死的；可恶的；糟透的
v. 咒骂（某人下地狱）
words.ex: It's a damn good idea.
words.ex_cn: 这是个该死的好主意。
words.en: If you say that someone is damned if they do something, you mean that they will be in a very difficult situation if they do it.

words.tr:
adj. 裸体的
n. 裸体；裸体画；裸体像
words.ex: He painted a nude woman by the window.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一位在窗边的裸体女性。
words.en: A nude person is not wearing any clothes. A nude painting or sculpture shows a person who is not wearing any clothes.

words.tr:
n. 步枪；来复枪（又称来福枪）
v. 快速搜寻
words.ex: He carries a rifle in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他带着一把步枪在森林里。
words.en: A rifle is a gun with a long barrel which you hold against your shoulder when firing.

words.ex: He takes the tram to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上乘电车上班。
words.en: A tram is a vehicle that is used for public transportation in cities and towns, running on tracks laid in the streets.

words.tr: adj. 失去的；失踪的； v. 错失；“miss”的现在分词；
words.ex: The missing book was found under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 那本丢失的书在床下找到了。
words.en: If someone or something is missing, they are not in their usual place, and you cannot find them.

words.ex: He put vinegar on his salad.
words.ex_cn: 他把醋倒在沙拉上。
words.en: A sour-tasting liquid used as a condiment or preservative, typically made by fermenting dilute alcoholic liquids such as wine, cider, or beer.

words.ex: He bought a bottle of liquor for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对买了一瓶酒。
words.en: Liquor is an alcoholic drink that is made by distillation rather than by fermentation.

words.ex: He uses aluminum foil to wrap the food.
words.ex_cn: 他用铝箔纸包食物。
words.en: A light, silvery metal that is used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: He fastened the strap around his wrist.
words.ex_cn: 他把带子系在手腕上。
words.en: A strap is a narrow piece of leather, cloth, or other material that is used to fasten, secure, or carry something, or to hold onto something.

words.ex: We watched fireworks on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我们在除夕夜看了烟火。
words.en: Fireworks are small explosive devices that produce colorful displays of light and noise, typically used in celebrations.

words.ex: The lorry carried boxes to the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了仓库。
words.en: A lorry is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.tr: n. 优惠券；息票；配给券
words.ex: He used a coupon to buy milk at half price.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张优惠券以半价买了牛奶。
words.en: A coupon is a piece of printed paper that allows you to pay less money than usual for a product, or to get it free.

words.ex: He is learning the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习英文字母。
words.en: An alphabet is a set of letters or symbols in a fixed order used for writing a language.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.ex: He wrote a memorandum about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于会议的备忘录。
words.en: A memorandum is a written proposal or reminder, especially in a business context.

words.ex: The country made a declaration of independence.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家发表了独立宣言。
words.en: A declaration is a formal statement or announcement.

words.ex: He is learning biochemistry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习生物化学。
words.en: The branch of science concerned with the chemical processes occurring within living organisms.

words.ex: The address is 720 liberty street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是自由大街720号。
words.en: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.

words.tr:
n. 谜语；费解的事
v. 解谜；出谜；使布满窟窿；打洞
words.ex: He told me a riddle and I solved it.
words.ex_cn: 他给我出了一道谜语，我解出来了。
words.en: A riddle is a question or statement that is deliberately very confusing and has a clever or amusing answer.

words.ex: The climax of the movie was a big chase scene.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的高潮是一场大追捕场景。
words.en: The climax is the most exciting or important part of a play, film, or piece of music, which usually happens near the end.

words.ex: He composes music in his spare time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间创作音乐。
words.en: To compose something means to make it by combining parts or elements.

words.ex: He uses optical lenses to see small objects.
words.ex_cn: 他使用光学镜片来看小物体。
words.en: Relating to sight, especially in relation to the physical action of light.

words.ex: The lad is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A lad is a young man or boy.

words.ex: The glass is transparent.
words.ex_cn: 这玻璃是透明的。
words.en: If something is transparent, you can see through it.

words.ex: The battery gives out 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池输出9伏特。
words.en: A volt is a unit used to measure the force of an electric current.

words.ex: My brother's son is my nephew.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟的儿子是我的侄子。
words.en: A nephew is a son of one's sibling or sibling-in-law.

words.ex: The children play on the lawn after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在草坪上玩耍。
words.en: A lawn is an area of grass that is kept cut short and is usually part of someone's garden or yard, or part of a park.

words.ex: The phone vibrates when it receives a call.
words.ex_cn: 当手机收到电话时，它会震动。
words.en: To vibrate means to move rapidly to and fro or up and down; to oscillate.

words.ex: He eats a cucumber for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一根黄瓜。
words.en: A cucumber is a long, green vegetable with a high water content, used in salads and for pickling.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.tr:
n. 梳子
v. 梳理；搜寻
words.ex: He uses a comb to tidy his hair.
words.ex_cn: 他用梳子整理头发。
words.en: A comb is a flat piece of plastic or metal with narrow pointed teeth along one side, which you use to make your hair neat.

words.tr:
n. 标签；标记；
v. 加标签于；
words.ex: The tag on the shirt says 'wash cold'.
words.ex_cn: 衬衫上的标签写着‘冷水洗涤’。
words.en: A tag is a small piece of card, cloth, or plastic which is attached to an object or person and has information about that object or person on it. A tag can also be a word or phrase that is used to describe or identify something, especially in a computer file or on a website.

words.ex: His speech was coherent and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲连贯且易于理解。
words.en: If something is coherent, it is well planned, so that it is clear and sensible and all its parts go well with each other.

words.tr:
n. 紧握；掌握；控制；
v. 紧握；掌握；
words.ex: He has a strong grip on the handle.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握住把手。
words.en: To grip something means to hold it tightly. It can also mean to hold someone's attention completely.

words.ex: The painter used a roller to apply the paint.
words.ex_cn: 油漆工用滚筒来涂油漆。
words.en: A roller is a cylinder that rotates around a central axis and is used in various machines and devices to move, flatten, or compress something.

words.ex: This plant produces electricity using nuclear power.
words.ex_cn: 这座电厂使用核能发电。
words.en: relating to the nucleus of an atom, or to the energy produced when the nucleus of an atom is split or joined with another nucleus

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: Ozone is a form of oxygen that has three atoms in each molecule, and it is a pale blue gas with a pungent smell. It is found in the Earth's atmosphere and absorbs ultraviolet radiation, which is harmful to living organisms.

words.ex: She blesses her children every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上为孩子们祝福。
words.en: If someone is blessed with a particular good quality or skill, they have that good quality or skill.

words.ex: He spoke quietly lest he wake the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他低声说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If you do something lest something unpleasant should happen, you do it to try to prevent the unpleasant thing from happening.

words.ex: The repetition of the same words made the lesson boring.
words.ex_cn: 相同词语的重复让这堂课变得无聊。
words.en: The act of repeating something that has already been said or written.

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: There is a rumour that he will quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 有一个传言说他要辞职。
words.en: A rumour is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.ex: The people tried to overthrow the corrupt government.
words.ex_cn: 人民试图推翻腐败的政府。
words.en: To overthrow a government or a leader means to remove them from power, often by force.

words.ex: We watched the sunset by the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海滩上看了夕阳。
words.en: The time in the evening when the sun disappears or daylight fades.

words.ex: The mechanic tightened the bolt with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用扳手拧紧了螺栓。
words.en: A bolt is a type of fastener consisting of a threaded pin or rod with a head at one end, designed to be inserted through holes in assembled parts and tightened by a nut from the other end. It can also refer to a sudden dash or run, or to eat food quickly and without chewing.

words.tr:
n. 琐事；少量
v. 玩弄；轻视
words.ex: He threw away a trifle of money on candy.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一点钱买糖果。
words.en: A trifle is something that is considered to have little importance, value, or significance. It can also refer to a small amount of something. As a verb, to trifle means to treat someone or something without seriousness or respect.

words.tr:
v. 大步行走；跨一大步
n. 大步；步伐
words.ex: He takes a long stride when he walks.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时迈着大步。
words.en: To walk with long, decisive steps in a specified direction.

words.tr:
v. 叹息；叹气
n. 叹息；叹气
words.ex: He sighed when he saw the messy room.
words.ex_cn: 他看到凌乱的房间时叹了口气。
words.en: To sigh is to let out a deep breath slowly and audibly, often as a sign of sadness, tiredness, or relief.

words.ex: A butterfly is flying over the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝴蝶在花上飞舞。
words.en: A butterfly is an insect with large, often brightly coloured wings.

words.ex: He bought a recorder to record his lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一台录音机来录课程。
words.en: A recorder is a device or a person that records something, especially sounds or events.

words.ex: His humour makes everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他的幽默让每个人都笑起来。
words.en: Humour is the quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech.

words.ex: The apple weighs 150 gramme.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果重150克。
words.en: A gramme is a metric unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.

words.ex: He lives in a tropical island near the equator.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赤道附近的一个热带岛屿上。
words.en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

words.tr: v. 使发狂；使发疯；使发怒
words.ex: The loud noise madden him.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让他发狂。
words.en: To make someone extremely angry or annoyed.

words.ex: He loves watching stars and learning astronomy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看星星并学习天文学。
words.en: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.ex: He chopped the carrots into small pieces.
words.ex_cn: 他把胡萝卜剁成了小块。
words.en: To chop something means to cut it into pieces with a sharp tool such as a knife or axe. It can also refer to the act of reducing something in amount or size.

words.ex: The ratio of boys to girls is 3 to 2.
words.ex_cn: 男孩与女孩的比例是3比2。
words.en: A ratio is a relationship between two numbers indicating how many times the first number contains the second.

words.ex: The bulb broke when it fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡掉到地上时碎了。
words.en: A bulb is the glass part of an electric lamp, which gives out light when electricity passes through it. It can also refer to a rounded underground storage organ present in some plants, notably those of the lily family, consisting of a short stem surrounded by fleshy scale leaves or leaf bases, lying dormant over winter.

words.ex: The apple is rotten and smells bad.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果腐烂了，闻起来很难闻。
words.en: Something that is rotten has decayed and cannot be used for its normal purpose.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；街道；附近地区；
words.ex: I walk my dog in the neighborhood every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上在街坊遛狗。
words.en: A neighborhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.ex: The police opened an enquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An enquiry is a question you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: He dug a hole with a spade.
words.ex_cn: 他用铁锹挖了一个洞。
words.en: A spade is a tool used for digging, with a sharp-edged, typically rectangular metal blade and a long handle. In card games, a spade is one of the four suits, represented by a black symbol resembling a pointed leaf with a short stem.

words.ex: The conductor raised his baton to start the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 指挥举起指挥棒，开始演奏交响乐。
words.en: A conductor is a person who directs the performance of an orchestra or choir, or a substance that allows heat or electricity to pass through it.

words.ex: He buys lunch in the school canteen.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校食堂买午餐。
words.en: A canteen is a place in a factory, office, or school where meals are served, often at a lower cost than in restaurants. It can also refer to a small container for carrying water or other drinks.

words.tr:
n. 耸肩
v. 耸肩
words.ex: He shrugged when asked why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 当被问到为什么迟到时，他耸了耸肩。
words.en: If you shrug, you raise your shoulders to show that you are not interested in something or that you do not know or care about something.

words.ex: The dam holds back the river water.
words.ex_cn: 水坝拦住了河水。
words.en: A dam is a barrier that stops or restricts the flow of water or underground streams. Reservoirs created by dams not only suppress floods but also provide water for activities such as irrigation, human consumption, industrial use, aquaculture, and navigability.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: The sentence has a clause that explains why he left.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子有一个解释他为什么离开的从句。
words.en: A clause is a particular section of a legal document such as a contract, will, or treaty, that contains a condition or stipulation.

words.ex: His answer was erroneous because he added wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案是错误的，因为他加错了。
words.en: If you describe someone's beliefs or opinions as erroneous, you mean that they are incorrect and based on false information.

words.ex: He drinks brandy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后喝白兰地。
words.en: Brandy is a strong alcoholic drink made from wine or fermented fruit juice.

words.ex: The gross income of the company is $5 million.
words.ex_cn: 公司的总收入是500万美元。
words.en: If you describe something as gross, you mean it is very obvious, unacceptable, or unpleasant.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.tr: n. 屠夫；肉贩； adj. “butch”的比较级；
words.ex: The butcher sold fresh meat at the market.
words.ex_cn: 屠夫在市场卖新鲜的肉。
words.en: A butcher is a person who prepares and sells meat. As a verb, to butcher means to kill and prepare animals for meat, or to kill people in a cruel and unnecessary way.

words.ex: The beggar sat on the street with a cup.
words.ex_cn: 那个乞丐坐在街上，手里拿着一个杯子。
words.en: A beggar is a person who lives by asking people for money or food.

words.ex: The company got a lot of publicity from the TV ad.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司从电视广告中获得了大量宣传。
words.en: Publicity is the activity of making sure that someone or something attracts a lot of interest or attention from the public, especially by providing information about them in newspapers, on television, etc.

words.ex: The sailors swam ashore after the boat sank.
words.ex_cn: 船沉没后，水手们游到了岸上。
words.en: If someone or something comes ashore, they come from the sea onto the shore.

words.tr: adj. 光荣的；可敬的；尊敬的
words.ex: He is an honorable man who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是说真话的正直的人。
words.en: Deserving respect and admiration; having high moral standards.

words.tr:
n. 侦察兵；
v. 搜寻；
words.ex: The scout watched the enemy's movement quietly.
words.ex_cn: 侦察兵悄悄观察敌人的动向。
words.en: A scout is someone who is sent to an area of countryside to find out the position of an enemy or to search for a suitable place for a military camp.

words.ex: She sews a dress for her daughter.
words.ex_cn: 她为女儿缝制一件连衣裙。
words.en: To join, fasten, or repair something by making stitches with a needle and thread or a sewing machine.

words.ex: He sat on the rug near the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在壁炉旁的地毯上。
words.en: A rug is a piece of thick material that you put on the floor to cover part of it and to make it warmer or softer to walk on.

words.ex: It was her maiden flight on a plane.
words.ex_cn: 这是她第一次坐飞机。
words.en: A maiden is a young girl or woman who is not married.

words.ex: The apple's flesh is sweet and juicy.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的果肉又甜又多汁。
words.en: The soft substance consisting of muscle and fat that is found between the skin and bones of an animal or a human.

words.ex: The apple fell because of gravitation.
words.ex_cn: 苹果掉下来是因为重力。
words.en: Gravitation is the force of attraction that exists between any two masses, any two bodies, any two particles. It is the force that pulls objects towards each other.

words.tr: adj. 众所周知的；著名的
words.ex: He is a well-known singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: A well-known person, place, or thing is one that is known about by a lot of people.

words.ex: Reading books is his favorite pastime.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: A pastime is something that you do because you enjoy it or are interested in it, rather than as a job.

words.ex: He joined the navy after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他高中毕业后加入了海军。
words.en: The navy is the part of a country's armed forces that is trained to operate at sea.

words.ex: My throat is sore after singing.
words.ex_cn: 我唱歌后喉咙疼。
words.en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

words.ex: He is always punctual for class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课总是准时。
words.en: If you are punctual, you do something or arrive somewhere at the right time and are not late.

words.ex: The countries formed a federation to share resources.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家组成了一个联盟来共享资源。
words.en: A federation is a group of states or organizations that have joined together to form a single entity with a central government or authority.

words.ex: The pencil is 15 centimeters long.
words.ex_cn: 这支铅笔有15厘米长。
words.en: A centimeter is a unit of length in the metric system equal to one hundredth of a meter.

words.tr: n. 少女；女孩；年轻女子
words.ex: The lass is playing with her dog.
words.ex_cn: 这个小女孩正在和她的狗玩耍。
words.en: A lass is a young woman or girl.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.ex: She invited all her kin to the family reunion.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请了所有亲属参加家庭聚会。
words.en: Your kin are your relatives.

words.ex: He spilled powder on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把粉末撒在了地上。
words.en: A powder is a dry substance made up of very small particles. It can be used for various purposes, including cosmetics, cleaning, and cooking. As a verb, to powder means to apply or cover something with powder.

words.tr:
n. 烤肉；烘烤；
adj. 烤的；焙的；
v. 烤；烘烤；
words.ex: We had roast for dinner last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚我们吃了烤肉。
words.en: To cook food, such as meat, in an oven or over a fire.

words.tr:
v. 派遣；调遣；发送
n. 快信；发送；派遣
words.ex: He will dispatch the package tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会寄出这个包裹。
words.en: To send someone or something to a particular place for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The bug is five millimeters long.
words.ex_cn: 这只虫子五毫米长。
words.en: A unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter.

words.ex: The parliament passed a new law about education.
words.ex_cn: 国会通过了一项关于教育的新法律。
words.en: A parliament is a legislative body of government, typically composed of elected representatives, that is responsible for making laws and representing the interests of the people.

words.ex: The child was naked in the bathtub.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在浴缸里是裸体的。
words.en: If something is naked, it is not covered by anything such as clothes or paint.

words.ex: He held a pistol in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里拿着一把手枪。
words.en: A pistol is a small gun.

words.tr: n. 四轮运货马车；敞篷货车；
words.ex: The farmer used a wooden wagon to carry crops.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用一辆木制四轮运货马车运送庄稼。
words.en: A wagon is a vehicle with four wheels, usually pulled by horses or oxen, used for transporting goods.

words.ex: He bullies his little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都欺负他的弟弟。
words.en: To bully someone means to use your strength or power to hurt or frighten them, often forcing them to do something they do not want to do.

words.ex: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 从10中减去5得到5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.ex: He finally conceded defeat after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，他终于承认失败了。
words.en: If you concede something, you admit, often unwillingly, that it is true or correct.

words.ex: The ship uses GPS for navigation.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用GPS进行导航。
words.en: The process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.

words.ex: He rubbed his chin when he thought.
words.ex_cn: 他思考时摸了摸下巴。
words.en: The part of the face below the mouth and above the neck.

words.tr: n. 网络广播；网络直播
words.ex: He will webcast his speech tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将网络直播他的演讲。
words.en: A webcast is a transmission of audio or video content over the Internet using streaming media technology to distribute a single content source to many simultaneous listeners/viewers.

words.ex: He tried to bribe the officer with money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用钱贿赂官员。
words.en: A bribe is a sum of money or something valuable that one person offers or gives to another in order to persuade them to do something, usually something dishonest.

words.ex: He only read the partial report.
words.ex_cn: 他只读了部分报告。
words.en: If you describe something as partial, you mean that it is not complete or whole.

words.ex: The sailor fixed the rope on the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手修理了船上的绳子。
words.en: A sailor is a person who works on a ship as a member of its crew.

words.tr: v. 喝；喝酒；“drink”的过去分词； adj. 喝醉的；
words.ex: He has drunk all the water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了所有的水。
words.en: If someone is drunk, they have consumed so much alcohol that it has affected their ability to think and speak clearly.

words.ex: He worked hard to fulfill his dream.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的梦想。
words.en: To fulfill a task, role, or function means to do or perform it as required or expected.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.ex: There was frost on the grass this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上草地上有霜。
words.en: A thin layer of ice that forms on surfaces when the temperature drops below freezing.

words.ex: The food at this restaurant is superb.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅的食物极佳。
words.en: If something is superb, its quality is very good indeed.

words.ex: The two teams clashed during the match.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍在比赛中发生了冲突。
words.en: A clash is a loud, harsh noise, like the clash of cymbals. It can also refer to a conflict or disagreement.

words.ex: He has a dual role as teacher and coach.
words.ex_cn: 他同时担任老师和教练的双重角色。
words.en: Having two parts or aspects.

words.ex: He picked up an axe to chop wood.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把斧子去砍柴。
words.en: An axe is a tool used for chopping wood, typically consisting of a heavy metal blade fixed at a right angle at the end of a long handle. As a verb, to axe means to dismiss or reduce something drastically.

words.ex: The car has 200 horsepower.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有200马力。
words.en: A unit of power equal to 550 foot-pounds per second (about 750 watts), used in measuring the power of engines or motors.

words.tr: n. 一圈；（人坐着时）大腿部；
words.ex: He ran three laps around the track.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑道上跑了三圈。
words.en: The upper part of the legs of a seated person; a single turn or round in a race or other competition.

words.ex: The team's cohesion helped them win the match.
words.ex_cn: 团队的凝聚力帮助他们赢得了比赛。
words.en: Cohesion refers to the action or fact of forming a united whole, especially in the context of a group of people or the parts of a substance.

words.ex: He tries to memorize the words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天试着记住这些单词。
words.en: To memorize something means to learn it so well that you can remember it perfectly.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.ex: He was amongst the first to arrive.
words.ex_cn: 他是最早到达的人之一。
words.en: If something is among other things, it is one of them.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.tr:
n. 长裤子；短内裤； “pant”的复数
v. 喘气；喘息；“pant”的第三人称单数
words.ex: He is wearing blue pants.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Pants are a piece of clothing that covers the body from the waist to the ankles and divides into two parts to cover each leg separately.

words.ex: The crocodile is swimming in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼正在河里游泳。
words.en: A crocodile is a large reptile that lives in rivers in the tropical regions of Africa, Asia, America, and Australia. It has a long body, a long tail, and very strong jaws.

words.ex: They erect a flagpole in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园里竖立一根旗杆。
words.en: If people erect something such as a building, bridge, or barrier, they build it or create it.

words.ex: The company updated the payroll last Friday.
words.ex_cn: 公司上星期五更新了职工工资册。
words.en: A payroll is a list of employees and the amount of money they are to be paid, or the total amount of money paid to the employees of a company.

words.ex: The cat used its claw to scratch the tree.
words.ex_cn: 猫用爪子抓树。
words.en: A claw is a curved pointed horny nail on each digit of the foot in birds, lizards, and some mammals. As a verb, it means to scratch, tear, or pull with claws or fingernails.

words.ex: The doctor checked his bowel for signs of infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的肠是否有感染迹象。
words.en: The lower part of the alimentary canal from the end of the stomach to the anus.

words.ex: He hurt his wrist while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他打篮球时伤了手腕。
words.en: The part of your body where your hand joins your arm.

words.ex: He sat on a wooden stool.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一个木凳上。
words.en: A stool is a seat without a back or arms, typically resting on three or four legs or on a single pedestal.

words.tr:
n. 树篱；防范措施
v. 用树篱围住；限制；避免
words.ex: He planted a hedge around his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园周围种了一排树篱。
words.en: A hedge is a row of bushes or small trees which have been planted along the edge of a garden, field, or road to separate it from another area or to protect it. As a verb, to hedge means to avoid committing oneself or to limit or qualify something by conditions or exceptions.

words.ex: He confesses that he made a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认自己犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you confess to doing something, you admit that you did it.

words.ex: He used 'she' as a pronoun in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他在句子中用'she'作为代词。
words.en: A pronoun is a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase. Pronouns refer to either a noun that has already been mentioned or to a noun that does not need to be named specifically.

words.ex: He compresses the file to save space.
words.ex_cn: 他压缩文件以节省空间。
words.en: To compress something means to press it or squeeze it so that it takes up less space.

words.ex: They used cement to build the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他们用水泥建造了这堵墙。
words.en: Cement is a powdery substance which is mixed with water and used for sticking things together or for making very hard surfaces.

words.ex: He kneel to pray every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跪下祈祷。
words.en: To kneel means to go down into a position where one or both knees are on the ground.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an injection for the pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他打了一针来缓解疼痛。
words.en: An injection is the act of putting a liquid, especially a drug, into a person's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.ex: He took a pill for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒药丸来缓解头痛。
words.en: A pill is a small solid mass of medicine that you swallow whole.

words.ex: He looks at the bug through a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过显微镜观察这只虫子。
words.en: An instrument used for viewing objects that are too small to be seen by the naked eye, especially one that uses a combination of lenses to produce a magnified image.

words.ex: He stepped on my heel by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心踩到了我的脚后跟。
words.en: The heel is the back part of the foot, below the ankle. It can also refer to the part of a shoe or boot that supports this part of the foot.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.ex: The kettle produces vapour when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生水汽。
words.en: Vapour is a substance in the gas phase at a temperature lower than its critical temperature, which means that the vapour can be condensed to a liquid by increasing its pressure without reducing the temperature.

words.ex: He listens to a podcast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听播客。
words.en: A podcast is a digital audio file made available on the internet for downloading to a computer or mobile device, typically available as a series, new installments of which can be received by subscribers automatically.

words.tr: adj. 习惯的；惯常的； v. “accustom”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you know it so well or have experienced it so often that it seems natural, unsurprising, or easy to deal with.

words.ex: She picked up the coil of rope from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 她从地上捡起了那卷绳子。
words.en: A coil is a length of something wound in a joined sequence of loops, or the act of winding something into loops.

words.tr: prep. 关于； v. 看待；“regard”的现在分词；
words.ex: He sent me an email regarding the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给我发了一封关于会议的邮件。
words.en: You can use regarding to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

words.tr: v. 给予；发出；“give”的过去式；
words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一本书。
words.en: Past tense of give, which means to freely transfer the possession of something to someone.

words.ex: I am awaiting the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我正在等公交车。
words.en: If you await someone or something, you wait for them.

words.ex: He felt awkward when he forgot his friend's name.
words.ex_cn: 当他忘记朋友的名字时，他感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you describe a situation as awkward, you mean that it is embarrassing or difficult to deal with.

words.ex: The municipal library is open every day.
words.ex_cn: 这座市政图书馆每天都开放。
words.en: Relating to a city or town or its governing body.

words.ex: He wiped the sweat from his brow.
words.ex_cn: 他擦去了额头上的汗水。
words.en: The brow refers to the eyebrow or the forehead, and can also denote the top edge of a steep place such as a cliff.

words.ex: He writes simple prose every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写简单的散文。
words.en: Prose is written language in its ordinary form, without metrical structure.

words.ex: He carries a briefcase to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带着公文包去上班。
words.en: A briefcase is a flat, rectangular container with a handle, used especially for carrying papers and documents.

words.tr:
n. 弹跳；跳动；
v. 弹跳；反弹；
words.ex: The ball had a high bounce on the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 球在混凝土上弹跳得很高。
words.en: If something bounces or if you bounce it, it moves away from a surface after hitting it.

words.ex: The birds flew home at dusk.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回家。
words.en: Dusk is the time just before night when the daylight has almost gone but when it is not completely dark.

words.ex: He drew a graph to show the temperature changes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个图表来显示温度变化。
words.en: A graph is a mathematical diagram which shows the relationship between two or more sets of numbers or measurements.

words.ex: He wore a big grin after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得比赛后露出了灿烂的咧嘴笑容。
words.en: If you grin, you smile broadly, usually showing your teeth.

words.tr: n. 旁观者；看热闹的人；局外人
words.ex: The bystander watched the accident but did not help.
words.ex_cn: 旁观者看着这起事故，但没有帮忙。
words.en: A bystander is a person who is present at an event or incident but does not take part.

words.ex: Mother's milk nourishes the baby.
words.ex_cn: 母乳滋养婴儿。
words.en: To nourish someone or something means to provide them with the food and other substances they need in order to live, grow, and be healthy.

words.ex: There is a big statue in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 城市中心有一座巨大的雕像。
words.en: A statue is a large sculpture of a person or an animal, made of stone or metal.

words.ex: He used 'in' as a preposition in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他在句子中用 'in' 作为介词。
words.en: A preposition is a word such as 'by', 'for', 'into', or 'with' which usually has a noun group as its object.

words.ex: The old man walks with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人拄着藤杖走路。
words.en: A cane is a long, thin stick that you can use to help you walk, or it is a stick used for punishing people by hitting them. It is also a tall, hard plant like bamboo, from which sugar is made.

words.tr:
v. 弯腰；俯身；卑屈；俯冲
n. 弯腰；屈背；屈服；俯冲
words.ex: He must stoop to enter the small door.
words.ex_cn: 他必须弯腰才能进入那扇小门。
words.en: If someone stoops, they bend their body forwards and downwards.

words.ex: His judgement was fair and smart.
words.ex_cn: 他的判断公正而明智。
words.en: The ability to make considered decisions or come to sensible conclusions.

words.ex: The wicked witch cast a spell on the prince.
words.ex_cn: 邪恶的女巫对王子施了咒语。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as wicked, you mean that they are very bad, immoral, or cruel.

words.ex: The children play near the fountain in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。
words.en: A fountain is a structure that squirts water into the air to create a visual or auditory effect, or a natural source of water.

words.tr:
v. 合唱；异口同声地说
n. 合唱团；合唱
words.ex: They chorus when the song reaches the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 当歌曲进行到桥段时，他们一起合唱。
words.en: A chorus is a part of a song which is repeated after each verse, or a group of people who sing together.

words.ex: The wheel rotates slowly.
words.ex_cn: 轮子缓慢地转动。
words.en: To rotate means to turn or cause to turn around an axis or center.

words.tr:
n. 否决；否决权
v. 否决
words.ex: The president used his veto to stop the law.
words.ex_cn: 总统行使否决权阻止了这项法律。
words.en: If someone in authority vetoes something, they forbid it, or they stop it from being put into action.

words.ex: The doctor used an x-ray to check his bone.
words.ex_cn: 医生用X光检查了他的骨头。
words.en: An X-ray is a type of radiation that can pass through most solid materials. X-rays are used in medicine to make images of the inside of the body.

words.tr: n. 造币；货币；货币制度；新造的词语
words.ex: The new coinage was made of silver.
words.ex_cn: 新的硬币是用银制成的。
words.en: Coinage refers to the system of coins used in a country, or the process of making coins. It can also refer to the invention of new words or phrases.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The bird hatched her eggs after three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟在三周后孵出了她的蛋。
words.en: To hatch means to cause an egg to break open so that a young animal can come out, or to plan secretly with other people to do something bad or illegal.

words.ex: He exclaim when he saw the surprise.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到惊喜时，他大喊起来。
words.en: If you exclaim, you say something suddenly and loudly, often because you are surprised, excited, or angry.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.ex: He majored in forestry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修森林学。
words.en: The science or practice of planting, managing, and caring for forests.

words.ex: The water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.ex: He speaks fluent English.
words.ex_cn: 他讲一口流利的英语。
words.en: If someone is fluent in a particular language, they can speak it easily and correctly.

words.ex: The electron moves around the nucleus.
words.ex_cn: 电子围绕原子核运动。
words.en: An electron is a tiny particle with a negative charge that is found in all atoms and plays a key role in electricity.

words.tr: v. 叙述；给（电视或电影）作旁白
words.ex: He will narrate the story to his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他将为他的小妹妹讲述这个故事。
words.en: If you narrate a story, you tell it from your own point of view.

words.ex: He found a dime on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上找到一枚一角硬币。
words.en: A dime is a coin worth ten cents, one tenth of a United States dollar.

words.ex: She has a slender figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: Someone or something that is slender is thin and graceful.

words.ex: The country uses metric units for weight and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家使用米制单位来衡量重量和距离。
words.en: A metric is a system of measurement that uses meters, liters, and grams as its basic units.

words.ex: He exaggerates his achievements to impress others.
words.ex_cn: 他夸张自己的成就来给别人留下印象。
words.en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

words.ex: The camera has a clear lens.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有一个清晰的透镜。
words.en: A lens is a piece of curved glass or other transparent substance that is used in things such as cameras, telescopes, or pairs of glasses to make images larger or smaller.

words.ex: He paid the first installment last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周支付了第一期分期付款。
words.en: An installment is one of the amounts, usually equal, into which a debt is divided for payment at stated intervals over a fixed period.

words.ex: He draws triangles in geometry class.
words.ex_cn: 他在几何课上画三角形。
words.en: Geometry is the branch of mathematics concerned with the properties and relations of points, lines, surfaces, solids, and higher dimensional analogs.

words.ex: The soldiers raided the enemy camp at night.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在夜间突袭了敌人的营地。
words.en: A raid is a sudden attack on a place by soldiers, police, or other officials, in order to search for something or to arrest someone.

words.ex: The clown made the children laugh.
words.ex_cn: 小丑让孩子们笑了。
words.en: A clown is a performer, typically in a circus, who wears a traditional costume and exaggerated makeup, and entertains by performing comedic acts.

words.ex: He threw the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A bin is a container that you put rubbish in.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.tr:
n. 公社；亲密的会谈
v. 亲密地交谈；与…融为一体
words.ex: The farmers lived in a commune in the 1970s.
words.ex_cn: 这些农民在20世纪70年代住在一个公社里。
words.en: A commune is a group of people who live together and share responsibilities and possessions, or the act of communicating intimately with someone or something.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.ex: The sun wakens the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳每天早晨唤醒鸟儿。
words.en: to stop sleeping or to make someone stop sleeping

words.tr:
v. 举起；投掷；起伏；喘息；呕吐
n. 举；投；掷；起伏
words.ex: He heave the box onto the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子举到了桌子上。
words.en: To lift or haul something heavy with great effort; to throw something forcefully; to rise and fall rhythmically or with effort.

words.ex: The stars seem eternal in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中的星星看起来是永久的。
words.en: If something is eternal, it lasts forever.

words.ex: The procession moved slowly down the street.
words.ex_cn: 行列缓缓沿着街道行进。
words.en: A procession is a group of people who are walking, riding, or driving in a line as part of a public event.

words.ex: The village suffered from famine last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个村庄遭受了饥荒。
words.en: A famine is a serious shortage of food in a country, which may cause many people to get sick or die.

words.ex: The country is working on modernization of its roads.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在努力改善其道路的现代化。
words.en: Modernization is the process of making something modern and more suited to present-day needs.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.ex: He keeps apples in the cellar.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果存放在地窖里。
words.en: A cellar is a room underneath a house, often used for storing things such as wine or coal.

words.ex: He scarcely ate anything at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐几乎没吃任何东西。
words.en: You use scarcely to emphasize that something is only just true or only just the case.

words.tr:
n. 海港；
v. 庇护；窝藏；
words.ex: The ship docked at the harbour at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 船在日落时停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbour is an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.ex: He had a mop of curly hair that always looked messy.
words.ex_cn: 他有一头乱蓬蓬的卷发，总是看起来很凌乱。
words.en: A mop is a tool for cleaning floors, consisting of a bundle of thick strings or a sponge attached to a long handle. As a verb, it means to clean or wipe something with a mop.

words.ex: She gave a heartfelt thank you to her teacher.
words.ex_cn: 她向老师真诚地表达了感谢。
words.en: If you describe something such as a feeling or emotion as heartfelt, you mean that it is genuine and strongly felt.

words.ex: The rain and the thunder happened in conjunction.
words.ex_cn: 雨和雷声同时发生。
words.en: A conjunction is a word that is used to connect clauses or sentences or to coordinate words in the same clause.

words.ex: The preceding chapter explains the basics.
words.ex_cn: 前一章解释了基础知识。
words.en: Existing or coming before something else in time, order, or importance.

words.tr: adj. 疯狂的；精神失常的；精神错乱的
words.ex: He thinks it's insane to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 他认为无证驾驶是疯狂的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as insane, you mean that they are very foolish or crazy.

words.ex: He walked sideways to avoid the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 他斜着走以避开水坑。
words.en: Moving or directed toward one side.

words.ex: He bought one liter of milk.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一升牛奶。
words.en: A liter is a metric unit of capacity, equal to one cubic decimeter.

words.ex: She showed great affection for her little dog.
words.ex_cn: 她对她的小狗非常钟爱。
words.en: A feeling of liking and caring for someone or something.

words.ex: The judge showed mercy and let him go free.
words.ex_cn: 法官仁慈地让他自由了。
words.en: If someone in authority shows mercy, they choose not to harm someone they have power over, or they forgive someone they have the right to punish.

words.ex: He read the preface before starting the book.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始读这本书之前读了序言。
words.en: A preface is an introduction at the beginning of a book, which explains what the book is about or why it was written.

words.ex: He pushed the trolley to carry the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他推着手推车来搬购物品。
words.en: A trolley is a small vehicle with wheels that can be pushed or pulled along and is used for carrying things.

words.ex: He tried to conceal the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图隐藏真相。
words.en: If you conceal something, you prevent it from being seen or known about.

words.ex: She ate a slice of toast for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片烤面包。
words.en: Toast is bread which has been cut into slices and made brown and crisp by cooking at a high temperature. Toast is also a drink in which you wish someone happiness or success.

words.tr: n. 引人注目的人或物；溅污的斑点；
words.ex: The new singer became a splash on the music scene.
words.ex_cn: 这位新歌手成为了音乐界引人注目的人物。
words.en: To cause (a liquid) to scatter in drops or small quantities, especially by striking or moving suddenly; to move or strike so as to cause a liquid to scatter in this way.

words.ex: He made a basket from bamboo.
words.ex_cn: 他用竹子做了一个篮子。
words.en: Bamboo is a tall tropical plant with hard, hollow stems. The young shoots of the plant can be eaten and the stems are used to make furniture.

words.tr:
n. 一条（面包）
v. 游荡；虚度光阴
words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: A loaf is a quantity of bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and usually sliced before being eaten. As a verb, to loaf means to spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

words.tr: n. 学习；学问； v. 学习；“learn”的现在分词；
words.ex: Learning takes time and practice.
words.ex_cn: 学习需要时间和练习。
words.en: The acquisition of knowledge or skills through study, experience, or being taught.

words.tr: n. 管道工程； v. “plumb”的现在分词；
words.ex: He works as a plumber and fixes plumbing in houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名水管工，负责修理房屋的管道工程。
words.en: The system of pipes, tanks, fittings, and other apparatus required for the water supply, heating, and sanitation in a building.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.ex: The king proclaimed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 国王宣告了一项新法律。
words.en: If you proclaim something, you formally announce it or declare it publicly.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.tr: n. 女用小包；钱包；资金；
words.ex: She put her keys in her purse.
words.ex_cn: 她把钥匙放进她的女用小包里。
words.en: A purse is a small bag used especially by women to carry everyday personal items.

words.ex: The barber cuts hair every day.
words.ex_cn: 理发师每天剪头发。
words.en: A barber is a person whose job is cutting men's hair and sometimes shaving their beards.

words.ex: The continual rain made the road very muddy.
words.ex_cn: 不停的雨让道路变得非常泥泞。
words.en: Something that is continual happens repeatedly over a period of time.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.tr:
n. 皱纹
v. 起皱纹；弄皱…
words.ex: He has a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。
words.en: A wrinkle is a small line or fold in something, especially fabric or the skin.

words.tr:
n. 鱼饵；诱惑物
v. 下诱饵
words.ex: He used bread as bait to catch fish.
words.ex_cn: 他用面包当诱饵来钓鱼。
words.en: Bait is something which is used to attract fish or animals so that they can be caught. It can also refer to something that is offered to someone to persuade them to do something.

words.ex: The law has a loophole that lets companies avoid taxes.
words.ex_cn: 这项法律有一个漏洞，让公司可以避税。
words.en: A loophole is a small mistake in a law or set of rules which allows people to do something that would otherwise be illegal or not allowed.

words.ex: The manager will authorize the payment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 经理明天将批准这笔付款。
words.en: To give official permission for something to happen, or to give someone official permission to do something.

words.ex: He speaks English with a French accent.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语时带有法国口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.ex: He lost his job because of his integrity.
words.ex_cn: 他因为正直而失去了工作。
words.en: Integrity is the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles.

words.ex: The bridge can withstand strong winds.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥能经受住强风。
words.en: If something or someone withstands a force or action, they survive it or do not give in to it.

words.ex: She wrote: 'I love reading.'
words.ex_cn: 她写道：‘我喜欢阅读。’
words.en: A colon is a punctuation mark consisting of two equally sized dots centered on the same vertical line. It is also used to refer to the part of the large intestine that extends from the cecum to the rectum.

words.ex: The camel walks slowly across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼缓慢地走过沙漠。
words.en: A camel is a large animal that lives in the desert and has one or two humps on its back.

words.ex: He has a natural aptitude for math.
words.ex_cn: 他天生有数学天赋。
words.en: An aptitude is a natural ability to do something.

words.tr:
v. 喷吐；吐痰；吐口水
n. 唾沫；一块陆地；烤肉叉
words.ex: He likes to spit watermelon seeds.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吐西瓜籽。
words.en: To spit means to force out the contents of the mouth, especially saliva, through the lips. It can also refer to the act of ejecting saliva or phlegm from the mouth, often as a gesture of contempt or disrespect.

words.tr: v. 砰地关上；猛地一动；抨击
words.ex: He slammed the door angrily.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地把门砰地关上。
words.en: If you slam a door or window, or if it slams, it shuts noisily and with great force.

words.ex: He looks at the stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer, containing an arrangement of lenses, or of curved mirrors and lenses, by which rays of light are collected and focused and the resulting image magnified.

words.tr:
adj. 马克思主义的
n. 马克思主义者
words.ex: He is a Marxist who believes in workers' rights.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位相信工人权利的马克思主义者。
words.en: A Marxist is someone who believes in the political and economic theories of Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels, especially the idea that capitalism will inevitably be replaced by socialism and then communism.

words.ex: The church is a holy place.
words.ex_cn: 教堂是一个神圣的地方。
words.en: If you describe something as holy, you mean that it is considered to be special because it is connected with God or a particular religion.

words.ex: The birds live in a quiet marsh.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在一片宁静的沼泽中。
words.en: A marsh is an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times.

words.tr: v. 学习；“learn”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有学问的；
words.ex: He learned to read when he was five.
words.ex_cn: 他五岁时学会了阅读。
words.en: A learned person has gained a lot of knowledge by studying.

words.tr:
n. 寓言；神话传说；无稽之谈
v. 虚构
words.ex: The old man told a fable about a fox and a crow.
words.ex_cn: 老人讲了一个关于狐狸和乌鸦的寓言。
words.en: A fable is a short story that typically features animals as characters and conveys a moral lesson.

words.ex: The coin is made of nickel.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币是镍制的。
words.en: A hard silver-white metal that is used in making alloys and is a chemical element. It is also a coin worth five cents in the US and Canada.

words.ex: He wore a funny costume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对穿了一套滑稽的服装。
words.en: A costume is a set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or historical period, or a set of clothes worn by an actor for a particular role.

words.ex: The team comprises five players and one coach.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和一名教练。
words.en: If you say that something comprises or is comprised of a number of things or people, you mean it has them as its parts or members.

words.tr: adj. 共和国的；共和政体的；
words.ex: The republican government passed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 共和国政府通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A republican is a person who supports or belongs to the Republican Party, which is one of the two main political parties in the United States. It can also refer to someone who supports a republic as a form of government.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.ex: She added pepper to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了胡椒粉。
words.en: Pepper is a hot-tasting powder made from the crushed seeds of certain plants, used to flavor food.

words.ex: The bird has a soft feather.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟有一根柔软的羽毛。
words.en: One of the light, horny structures that form the principal covering of birds.

words.tr: adj. 不足的；缺乏的；有缺陷的
words.ex: The plant is deficient in sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物缺乏阳光。
words.en: If someone or something is deficient in a particular thing, they do not have the full amount of it that they need.

words.tr:
n. 蜡；
v. 给…上蜡；
words.ex: Bees make wax to build their hives.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢。
words.en: Wax is a solid, slightly shiny substance made of fat or oil that is used to make candles, polish, and other products. It can also refer to the process of applying wax to something or the natural substance found in the ear.

words.ex: The lavatory is down the hall.
words.ex_cn: 洗手间在走廊尽头。
words.en: A lavatory is a room equipped with a toilet and sink for washing hands and face.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生（或出版等）的；准备好的；
words.ex: The forthcoming book will be released next month.
words.ex_cn: 即将出版的这本书将在下个月发布。
words.en: If something is forthcoming, it is happening or coming soon.

words.ex: The castle endured a long siege during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡在战争中经历了长期的围攻。
words.en: A siege is a military operation in which enemy forces surround a town or building, cutting off essential supplies, with the aim of compelling those inside to surrender.

words.ex: She wrote mother-in-law with a hyphen.
words.ex_cn: 她写 mother-in-law 时用了连字符。
words.en: A hyphen is a short line (-) used to connect the parts of a compound word or the parts of a word that has been split at the end of a line.

words.ex: The decision was made in accordance with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定是按照规则做出的。
words.en: Agreement or harmony; conformity.

words.tr: n. 习俗；习惯；关税；海关；“custom”的复数；
words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日里点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: The place at a port, airport, or border where officials check the goods or luggage of people entering or leaving a country, and where they collect taxes on goods being imported.

words.tr: adj. 圆圈的；环形的；循环的；
words.ex: The table has a circular top.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面。
words.en: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

words.ex: He spends hours in cyberspace every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在虚拟空间里花几个小时。
words.en: Cyberspace is the notional environment in which communication over computer networks occurs.

words.ex: Going first is a privilege, not a right.
words.ex_cn: 优先权是一种特权，而不是权利。
words.en: A privilege is a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.tr:
n. 坏女人；讨厌的女人
v. 埋怨；发牢骚；搞糟
words.ex: They are calling her bitch for no reason.
words.ex_cn: 他们无缘无故地叫她婊子。
words.en: A bitch is a female dog. In informal use, it can also refer to a woman who is regarded as malicious or unpleasant. As a verb, it means to complain in a petulant or whining manner.

words.ex: The miners dug deep to find iron ore.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们深入地下寻找铁矿石。
words.en: Ore is rock or earth from which metal can be obtained.

words.ex: Education is the cornerstone of a strong society.
words.ex_cn: 教育是强大社会的基石。
words.en: A cornerstone is an important quality or feature on which a particular thing depends or is based.

words.ex: He alleges that the manager stole money.
words.ex_cn: 他声称经理偷了钱。
words.en: If you allege that something bad is true, you say it but do not prove it.

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.tr: adj. 无价的；非常宝贵的；
words.ex: Her advice was invaluable to me.
words.ex_cn: 她的建议对我而言是无价的。
words.en: If you describe something as invaluable, you mean that it is extremely useful.

words.tr:
adj. 干净利落的；明确的
v. 清场伐木
words.ex: He gave a clear-cut answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了干净利落的答案。
words.en: A clear-cut situation or issue is easy to understand and deal with because it is obvious.

words.tr: adj. 琐碎的；微不足道的；心胸狭窄的
words.ex: He got angry over a petty mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一个微不足道的错误生气了。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as petty, you mean that they care too much about small, unimportant things and perhaps that they are unnecessarily unkind.

words.tr:
n. 崇拜；崇敬；礼拜；
v. 崇拜；尊崇；做礼拜；
words.ex: The ancient people showed worship to the sun.
words.ex_cn: 古人对太阳进行崇拜。
words.en: The feeling or expression of reverence and adoration for a deity.

words.tr:
n. 火焰
v. 燃烧；爆发；面红
words.ex: The candle flame flickered in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的火焰在风中摇曳。
words.en: A flame is a hot bright stream of burning gas that comes from something that is burning.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的过去式和过去分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school provides free lunch to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If a particular condition is true or if a particular event happens, then another condition will be true or another event will happen.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.ex: The bloody wound needed immediate care.
words.ex_cn: 那个流血的伤口需要立即治疗。
words.en: Covered or smeared with blood; involving or characterized by bloodshed or cruelty.

words.ex: He eats too much sugar and his liver is hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多糖，他的肝脏受损了。
words.en: The liver is a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and produces bile, or a person who lives in a particular way.

words.ex: The crane lifted the heavy steel beam.
words.ex_cn: 起重机吊起了沉重的钢梁。
words.en: A crane is a large machine that moves heavy things by lifting them in the air. It is also a large bird with long legs and a long neck.

words.tr:
v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有；挨着
n. 拥抱；搂抱
words.ex: She gave him a big hug when he arrived.
words.ex_cn: 他到达时，她给了他一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: To hug someone means to put your arms around them and hold them tightly, for example because you like them or are pleased to see them.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.ex: Ancient warfare used swords and shields.
words.ex_cn: 古代战争使用剑和盾。
words.en: Warfare is the activity of fighting a war.

words.ex: She rolled out the paste for the pie crust.
words.ex_cn: 她把面团擀平做派皮。
words.en: Paste is a soft, wet, sticky mixture of a powder and a liquid, which can be spread easily. It is also used to refer to the action of sticking something onto a surface using a sticky substance.

words.tr: v. 考虑；“consider”的现在分词； prep. 考虑到；就…而言；鉴于；
words.ex: I am considering going to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我正在考虑去公园。
words.en: Taking into account; in view of.

words.ex: The Magna Carta is an old charter of rights.
words.ex_cn: 《大宪章》是一份古老的权力宪章。
words.en: A charter is a formal document describing the rights, aims, or principles of an organization or group of people.

words.ex: There is ample food for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有足够的食物。
words.en: If there is an ample amount of something, there is enough of it and usually some extra.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.ex: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the river.
words.ex_cn: 农民用河里的水灌溉他们的田地。
words.en: To supply land or crops with water by means of channels or pipes.

words.ex: He loves zoology and studies animals in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱动物学，研究野外的动物。
words.en: Zoology is the scientific study of animals.

words.tr:
n. （果树的）花朵；
v. 开花；
words.ex: The apple tree is full of blossom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，苹果树上开满了花。
words.en: When a tree or plant blossoms, it produces flowers before producing fruit that can be eaten.

words.ex: The naughty boy broke his mother's vase.
words.ex_cn: 那个顽皮的男孩打碎了他妈妈的花瓶。
words.en: If you say that a child is naughty, you mean that they behave badly or do not do what they are told.

words.ex: He believes in socialism and wants equal rights for all.
words.ex_cn: 他相信社会主义，希望所有人都享有平等的权利。
words.en: Socialism is a political and economic theory of social organization which advocates that the means of production, distribution, and exchange should be owned or regulated by the community as a whole.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.ex: The scientist created a clone of the sheep.
words.ex_cn: 科学家克隆了一只羊。
words.en: A clone is an organism or cell produced asexually from one ancestor or stock, to which they are genetically identical.

words.tr:
n. 出纳员，收银员
v. 革除（军职）
words.ex: The cashier counted the money at the end of the day.
words.ex_cn: 收银员在一天结束时清点了钱。
words.en: A cashier is a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a shop, bank, or business.

words.ex: The sandpaper feels coarse to the touch.
words.ex_cn: 这张砂纸摸起来很粗糙。
words.en: Coarse things have a rough texture because they consist of thick threads or large pieces.

words.ex: The boat has a watertight hull.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船有一个不透水的船体。
words.en: Something that is watertight does not allow water to pass through it, often used to describe containers, compartments, or arguments that are completely secure and cannot be faulted.

words.ex: The class will commence at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程将在上午9点开始。
words.en: To begin something; to start.

words.tr: adj. 自发的；自然产生的；
words.ex: The children gave a spontaneous cheer.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们自发地欢呼起来。
words.en: Something that is spontaneous is not planned but happens or is done because of a sudden impulse or natural feeling.

words.ex: He is a so-called expert, but he knows little.
words.ex_cn: 他是个所谓的专家，但懂得很少。
words.en: used to show that something or someone is commonly designated by the name or term specified, often to suggest that the name or term is not appropriate or accurate
